messages.body_plain:
As I recall, Rattle does not do any automatic rescaling to 0-1 but
check the documentation for nnet to see if it does any (I have a
recollection that it does not but have not checked)? If not, then you
can scale easily to 0-1 under Rattle's transform tab. Go to Transform
-> Rescale -> Scale [0-1] then select the variables to transform, then
Execute.

Regards,
Graham
